g.text: SINK12 = U3 R-78HB12-0.5 output: always bus-fed sink/safety cluster. 1.1 W input envelope, pre-proof only.

g.desc: SINK12 = U3 R-78HB12-0.5 output: always bus-fed sink/safety cluster. 1.1 W input envelope, pre-proof only.

g.text: DRIVE12 = bus LM5164 (TI 12V reference values). LOGIC3V3_EXT = AP63203 from DRIVE12. Both EN held low by 100k.

g.desc: DRIVE12 = bus LM5164 (TI 12V reference values). LOGIC3V3_EXT = AP63203 from DRIVE12. Both EN held low by 100k.

g.text: DRIVE_EN = CTRL_PG AND MAIN_PROVEN_IN. MAIN_PROVEN_IN has a FITTED 0R inhibit to PGND.

g.desc: DRIVE_EN = CTRL_PG AND MAIN_PROVEN_IN. MAIN_PROVEN_IN has a FITTED 0R inhibit to PGND.

g.text: U510 is powered from SAFETY3V3, the always-on safety rail. Losing it floats Y: 100k pulldowns keep both EN low.

g.desc: U510 is powered from SAFETY3V3, the always-on safety rail. Losing it floats Y: 100k pulldowns keep both EN low.

g.text: NOT SAFE TO ENERGIZE. Partition of the former single AUX12V; no release or energization claim.

g.desc: NOT SAFE TO ENERGIZE. Partition of the former single AUX12V; no release or energization claim.

g.text: U501 is TI figure 7-1 (12 V/1 A/300 kHz) with RRON=100k and RFB1/RFB2=453k/49.9k. PGOOD sinks ANALOG_OK.

g.desc: U501 is TI figure 7-1 (12 V/1 A/300 kHz) with RRON=100k and RFB1/RFB2=453k/49.9k. PGOOD sinks ANALOG_OK.

g.text: U502 pin map per Diodes TSOT26 table; FB tied to VOUT for the fixed 3.3 V variant.
